page.layout: One column of running text on one printed page. Running head at the top, page number at the top right. No marginal notes. Catchword at the foot on the right.

main_text.p: vult, adeoque se & Ecclesiam, quæ ipsis committenda est olim, periculo exponant. Nonò denique necessaria est hæc doctrina ad vindicandas Ecclesias nostras à calumniis adversariorum. Remonstrantes enim hinc inde in scriptis suis præcipuè autem in Apologia acerbissimè insectantur Ecclesias nostras, quasi duas collaterales summas & architectonicas potestates statuant: Magistratum scilicet ex unâ, ministros ex altera parte; quorum ille tantum in rebus seculi; hi autem in rebus Ecclesiasticis gubernationem habeant; quâ ratione Magistratus à nobis mancipia, lictores, & carnifices (prout in Papatu sit) Ecclesiasticorum constitui dicunt, Apolog. c. 25. f. 293. 294. speciatim autem eo nomine acerbè insectantur Ecclesiam Genevensem, & Matricem, inquiunt, Ecclesiarum omnium Genevam tantùm vide ,&c. page.notes: The running head begins with a symbol that I read as Q with a stroke (§-like); marked [?]. The page number 137 and running head are printed at the top. The catchword "auctori-" is printed alone at the right below the last line. "speciatim" and "insectantur" are read from the scan with the long s rendered as plain s. The text has no visible paragraph indent, so it is one paragraph continuing from the previous page. No marginal notes are printed.
